scoring_justification: Absolute RE magnitude depends on Mie solver details and Si refractive-index model; structural features (peak wavelength, off-resonance suppression, stored-energy peak) are robust and identify the correct magnetic dipole resonance.

outputs.description: CSV file containing the computed Raman enhancement and stored electric energy enhancement as functions of excitation wavelength for a silicon nanosphere of radius 110 nm.

steps.description: Verify structural features of the Raman enhancement curve: peak wavelength, off-resonance suppression, stored-energy peak, and RE > SE at the peak.
